correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of the eight activation sets reproduces the exact joint three-variable PGF and symbolic differentiation verifies all three Rayleigh differences equal p²(1-p)/12 [p²(z_k−b_ij)²+(8−8p−p²)/4] with stated shifts. Thus at 0<p<1 stability iff p<=2sqrt(6)-4 by the all-real multiaffine criterion; p=1 gives independent continuous lower-record indicators. The iid thinned-minimum coupling exactly realizes the Markov kernel. Strict stochastic dominance of X_i after an actual jump against its unconditional distribution and strictly increasing later jump hazard give negative covariances for all i<j, 0<p<1. Earlier univariate PGF matches a positive-weight Meixner orthogonal polynomial after c=1-p transform and hence factors into Bernoulli PGFs; p=1 handled separately. Two-variable Bernoulli stability follows from nonpositive covariance, proving minimal horizon. No assertion for 4+ time strong Rayleigh.

value.rationale: A sharp minimum-horizon counterexample to the inference from pairwise negative covariance and Poisson-binomial sums to strong Rayleigh dependence is an intrinsically motivated structural classification. The restoration at the p=1 endpoint identifies the role of the upper atom in the record process; this is not an arbitrary numerical slice.

limitations: Three-time strong Rayleigh only; univariate result and general criterion are prior; p=1 exceptional independent endpoint.
